## CELL FACTS

Cell 木_伤官 (Wood carrying The Virtuoso). Persona The Virtuoso (伤官). Definition line: "Cross-current output, brilliance made of what it meets". Keyword Brilliance, charge fierce, poles catalyst Spark / friction Pushback. Family function: Expression. Cost dimension: brilliance against the grain; shining reads as defiance. Arena: the stage, spark, off-script, the note held too long. Classical portrait: brilliance and defiance; output that exceeds its container; 傲物气高, cannot hold its tongue. Ruled domains: Talent, Performance, Defiance. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 食神.
Element arena: Wood (trunk, branch, root, grain, growth, the forest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Water. structural_interaction seed: "Water generating Wood cross-polarity — depth producing reach that exceeds its container".
- k2_overview: "Your Wood moves as the Virtuoso: growth that will not stay trellised. You branch where the plan said hedge, flower out of season, and produce originality the way forests produce spring, excessively and without apology. Every constraint reads as a suggestion. Your best work grows exactly where they told you nothing could."
- k2_functional: "You express organically and abundantly, ideas leafing faster than any format can hold."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Chaotic","Sprawling","Defiant"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Talent":"Your talent is generative: new shoots daily, whole canopies of ideas. The gift needs an editor the way forests need clearings. Cut sightlines through your own abundance so the best trees show.","Performance":"You perform by unveiling growth: the project no one authorized, suddenly in bloom. Time the reveals. A garden shown at flowering converts skeptics that a garden shown as seeds cannot.","Defiance":"Your defiance is botanical: quiet, continuous, growing over walls rather than arguing with them. It wins by finished fact. Just verify the wall you are overgrowing is not holding your own soil."}

- Sibling cell 木_食神 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Fruitful","Mellow","Tending"],"friction":["Overripe","Lax","Overbooked"]}
- Sibling cell 木_食神 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your output ripens naturally and keeps coming. The dinners, the small gifts, the finished little projects: none announced, all delivered, season after season. Where others sprint and stall, you simply bear, and the people around you have quietly reorganized their lives around the harvest."

Core element Water, energy element Wood. Law: Water feeds Wood (水生木: rain raises the forest). Relative to the core the energy is the fed, so Wood is this core's Expression. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Water core that shows Wood on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Wood as the Expression is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 水_木's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You speak up where silence would be easier. Holding a true thing in feels worse to you, so you speak rather than wait for a welcome. If you let a few conversations go cold, you get to keep speaking up as yourself.

value_b.text: Holding your tongue has never been your strength. You trust what you see more than the comfort of whoever hears it, and speak up before you soften it. When you speak up like that, you buy honesty with a little peace.

value.text: For you, speaking up is never free. Honesty matters more to you than being liked, so you say the hard thing and sit alone in the quiet after. Bring one ally before you speak up, and you give up fewer chances to it.

value.text: Going off script is where you shine. Since a fresh idea counts for more with you than a given plan, you leave the script instead of following it. Once you tell others you are going off script, you keep their trust along with your idea.

value_b.text: You leave the script once you see a better way. Following to the letter wastes the part of you that improves things, and you fix a plan rather than finish it. Whenever the plan is yours alone, go off script all the way.

value.text: Standing out comes naturally to you. You would rather stand out than fit in, since hiding what you can do is a small lie to yourself. Each time you stand out, you trade a little ease for a voice that is yours.

value_b.text: You stand out in any group without trying to. Fitting in would mean hiding most of your talent, and you pick being seen ahead of being safe. Let yourself stand out, since a little wrong attention is a fair price for being seen.
